case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Selvbrunn the longest planning horizon with the full binding volume, and the claims below show why the price in it is the right level.

On the cost side:
Our forecast for Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 rises 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

On price history:
Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 416.33; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 415.11; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

It is a single, clear decision the committee can approve as it stands.

Since a step of this kind goes beyond your own approval, we would ask you to take Option A to the committee. If it helps, we will gladly provide whatever documentation its approval needs.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have reviewed your verified data regarding volume and delivery, which allows us to adjust our position. 

As to the delivery record and price history and volume change data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We cannot accommodate the price levels you proposed, as our pricing is strictly bound by current cost structures. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.

Our current offer is a price of €431.63 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

As an alternative, while our base prices are currently frozen, we can offer a revised price of EUR 429.43 by extending the contract to 24 months and adjusting the payment terms to 45 days, with a price of €429.43 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You said you can talk about terms instead of price while your base prices are frozen. Option A does exactly that: it gives Selvbrunn a binding volume over a full contract term, with the payment term you offered yourselves.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 420.71; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 418.24; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 417.02; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Binding volume in every option: 4,580 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve, because it gives your pricing committee the longest planning certainty and the full binding volume in one clear step. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

For your decision-maker, in plain words: Option A secures a binding volume every year across the whole contract term, at the payment term Selvbrunn itself proposed, with no open points left for either side. It can be approved as it stands.

Please take Option A to your pricing committee. If it needs anything from us to put the case together, we will provide it promptly.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
